material.acceptance_criteria: parseGlb rejects a POSITION accessor whose type is not VEC3, or readAccessor returns the vertex count; a live witness on a non-VEC3 POSITION fixture shows the error.
material.description: js/client/glb.js:73-74 and :76. parseGlb derives the index count from positions.length / 3, while readAccessor (line 36) owns the element width from accessor.type. The 3 is a second copy of the VEC3 fact, so a non-VEC3 POSITION accessor is not rejected at the accessor boundary and yields a wrong index count.
material.resolution: verifier: VEC3 POSITION gives 3 indices; VEC2 throws 'glb: accessor 0 is VEC2, expected VEC3'. CI run 39065835817 success on tip e03ee19 (24/24 jobs), which contains this sha
